title: Bend up, then pre-bend and release
description: Two half notes on string 3, both sounding D4. The first carries a whole-step bend as a curve: alter 0 at position 0 rising to alter 2 at position 1. The second is the inverse gesture — a pre-bend: alter already 2 at position 0, held to the midpoint, released to 0 by the end. Bends are curves of {position, alter} in semitones, not a single interval, which is exactly what MusicXML cannot say (its bend is one number) and why the extension drafts this shape. The renderer does not draw bends yet; the goldens pin the annotated notes rendering cleanly on both staves.
